request.spec:
A DRAFT claim can be deleted (a button on the claim; any other status, or a claim in a closed
period, is refused with an error on the claim): its status becomes DELETED, it counts nowhere (not
in any total, not in the status counts of the header or the summary), it cannot be edited, opened
or voided, its log gains a DELETED line, and CLAIM_DELETED is written naming the claim. On the same
sheet-today it was deleted, a restore button makes it a DRAFT again (CLAIM_RESTORED, a DRAFT line in
the log); on a later day the restore is refused.
request.prompt:
You are implementing ONE change to this application.

FIRST read AGENTS.md — it states the working rules and how the app is tested, and sends you to
DESIGN.md for the app's stack and conventions. Follow both.

THE CHANGE REQUEST:
A DRAFT claim can be deleted (a button on the claim; any other status, or a claim in a closed
period, is refused with an error on the claim): its status becomes DELETED, it counts nowhere (not
in any total, not in the status counts of the header or the summary), it cannot be edited, opened
or voided, its log gains a DELETED line, and CLAIM_DELETED is written naming the claim. On the same
sheet-today it was deleted, a restore button makes it a DRAFT again (CLAIM_RESTORED, a DRAFT line in
the log); on a later day the restore is refused.

Your work is verified by an automated Playwright UI test already installed under e2e/specs/.
Read that spec: it declares the exact data-testid anchors, values, test data and any audit
records it expects — match them. Run `bin/e2e` to build the app, start it, and run the test as
you work; iterate until it passes. Change whatever the request needs across the app — its stored
data, its server and its front end. Do NOT edit bin/build, bin/start, bin/stop, bin/e2e,
AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md, DESIGN.md, e2e/support/ or the test spec.

agent.result_text:
Delete and restore are working: the main test and scenarios 1 and 2 pass. `bin/e2e` still fails overall, because scenario 3 fails on every run. That scenario never deletes or restores anything; it fails on the existing consolidated figures, and I left that alone.

**What I changed**
- **New `ClaimDelete.java`:** Delete only works on a DRAFT, and is refused for a claim in a closed period, on an archived sheet, or while another user has the claim open for editing. It sets the status to DELETED, adds a DELETED line to the log and writes `CLAIM_DELETED … person= amount= date=`. Restore only works on a DELETED claim and only on the same sheet-today it was deleted. It makes the claim a DRAFT again, adds a DRAFT line and writes `CLAIM_RESTORED`. A refusal writes nothing.
- **Wiring:** `ChangeClaimStatus` sends the `delete` and `restore` actions through the existing `/claims/{claimId}/{action}` endpoint.
- **Same-day check:** I added `ClaimRepository.deletedToday` to look up when the claim was last deleted.
- **Proofs:** adding a proof to a DELETED claim is now refused too. The request didn't ask for this; I added it because it's in line with "cannot be edited".
- **Front end:** the claim row has new Delete and Restore buttons, and `ClaimStatus` includes `DELETED`.
- **Nothing else needed changing:** totals and the status counts in the header and summary only count the listed statuses, so a DELETED claim counts nowhere. Edit, open and void already refuse anything that isn't in an allowed status.

**Why scenario 3 fails** (`acceptance.spec.ts:1125`)

The scenario views the sheet as of 2026-03-15 and then expects `consolidated-people-count` to be `2` while `header-people-count` is `0`. In this app the consolidated count uses the same people data as the header, and every request is sent with the as-of date. On that date the sheet's people didn't exist yet and it has no child sheets. I checked the server's actual responses, and both counts are 0 every time. The test seems to expect the consolidated figures to ignore the as-of date and show the live count (Ben and Ada). Nothing in my change affects this.

Decision for you: making it pass means changing an unrelated feature so the consolidated figures always show the live sheet, even while viewing a past date. I didn't do that because it's outside this change request. Tell me if you want it and I'll make the change.
